Bài mẫu Level B1 269 từ
Bấm vào câu bất kỳ để xem dịch nghĩa tiếng Việt

In recent years, more and more young people have chosen to change jobs frequently instead of working for the same company for many years. This essay will discuss the main reasons for this trend and explore its effects on employees.

There are two main reasons for this trend. Firstly, many young people want to earn a higher salary. When they work for a company for a long time, their income may not increase as quickly as they expect. Therefore, they often look for another job that offers better pay and benefits. Secondly, young workers want to find a job that matches their interests and personal goals. For example, some people may realize that their current job is too stressful or does not give them enough opportunities to develop themselves. As a result, they decide to leave and find a more suitable position.

This trend can have two important effects on young people. On the one hand, changing jobs can help them improve their skills. By working in different companies, they can learn new ways of doing things and become more confident in their careers. However, changing jobs too frequently can make their careers less stable. They may have to spend some time looking for a new job after leaving their previous company. During this period, they may not have a regular income, which can make it difficult to pay for daily expenses.

In conclusion, young people often change jobs because they want higher salaries and more suitable working environments. Although this trend can help them improve their skills, it may also make their careers and financial situations less stable.

Bài mẫu Level B2 269 từ
Bấm vào câu bất kỳ để xem dịch nghĩa tiếng Việt

Nowadays, more and more young people choose to change jobs frequently instead of working for the same company for many years. This essay will explore the main reasons behind this trend and discuss its effects on young workers.

Several factors can explain why young people often change jobs. Firstly, they want to earn a higher salary. In some companies, employees may work for several years but receive only small salary increases. As a result, young people may look for other jobs that offer better pay and benefits. In addition, many young workers want to find a job that matches their interests and personal goals. For example, they may feel unhappy with their current jobs because of heavy workloads or limited opportunities for self-improvement. Therefore, they decide to look for a more suitable working environment.

This trend can have two main effects on young people. On the one hand, changing jobs can help them gain more experience and improve their skills. When they work for different companies, they have opportunities to learn new things, meet different people and become more confident. However, changing jobs too often can make their careers less stable. After leaving a company, they may need a long time to find another job. During this period, they may not have a regular income, making it difficult to cover daily expenses such as rent, food and transportation.

In conclusion, young people often change jobs because they want better salaries and jobs that suit their interests. Although this trend can help them gain experience and develop their skills, it may also lead to an unstable career and financial difficulties.

Bài mẫu Level B1 272 từ
Bấm vào câu bất kỳ để xem dịch nghĩa tiếng Việt

Nowadays, conflicts between parents and teenage children are becoming more common in many families. This essay will discuss the main reasons for this problem and suggest some possible solutions.

There are two main reasons for conflicts between parents and their teenage children. One common reason is that parents and teenagers often have different opinions about many things, such as clothing, friends and free-time activities. Parents usually want their children to follow their advice and make safe choices, while teenagers want more freedom to make their own decisions. This can easily lead to arguments at home. Another reason is that parents and their children do not communicate regularly. Many parents are busy with work and do not spend enough time talking with their children. As a result, teenagers may feel that their parents do not understand their feelings or problems.

Several measures can be taken to deal with this issue. Firstly, parents should spend more time with their children, such as having dinner together or talking about their daily activities. This can help family members understand each other better. Secondly, parents should listen to their children's opinions instead of always telling them what to do. This makes teenagers feel respected and more willing to share their thoughts. Finally, teenagers should also learn to respect their parents' advice because it usually comes from love and concern for their future. They should try to discuss problems calmly rather than getting angry or shouting.

In conclusion, conflicts between parents and teenagers mainly result from different opinions and poor communication. Both sides should listen to and respect each other to build a closer and happier family relationship.

Bài mẫu Level B2 292 từ
Bấm vào câu bất kỳ để xem dịch nghĩa tiếng Việt

In modern society, conflicts between parents and their teenage children have become a common problem in many families. This essay will discuss the main reasons behind this problem and suggest some possible solutions to address this issue.

Several factors can explain why conflicts happen between parents and teenagers. One common reason is that they often have different perspectives. Parents usually have more life experience, so they want their children to follow their advice and avoid making mistakes. However, teenagers often want more freedom to choose their clothes, friends and activities. These differences can easily cause arguments at home. Another reason is that parents and their children may not communicate effectively. Many parents are busy with their jobs and have little time to talk with their children. As a result, teenagers may feel lonely or believe that their parents do not understand their feelings and personal problems.

Several measures can be taken to deal with this issue. Firstly, parents should make more time for their children by having meals together or asking about their day. This helps family members stay connected and understand each other better. In addition, parents should listen carefully to their children's opinions instead of making all decisions for them. When teenagers feel that their ideas are respected, they are more likely to share their problems with their parents. Finally, teenagers should also learn to respect their parents' advice and understand that their parents usually want the best for them. Instead of arguing or getting angry, they should discuss their problems in a calm way.

In conclusion, conflicts between parents and teenagers mainly come from different opinions and poor communication. To improve family relationships, both sides need to spend more time together, listen to each other and show greater respect.

    Nowadays, stress has become ... Whether they are ..., they often feel ...

    This essay will discuss the main causes of stress among young people.

II. Thân bài 1 — Áp lực từ học tập, công việc và tài chính

  1. Câu chủ đề: Một nguyên nhân lớn gây căng thẳng là áp lực từ việc học và công việc.

IV. Kết bài

  1. Tóm gọn các nguyên nhân chính (áp lực học tập – công việc, so sánh trên mạng xã hội, thói quen sống chưa lành mạnh) và nhấn mạnh người trẻ cần quản lý thời gian tốt, chăm sóc sức khỏe thể chất lẫn tinh thần.

Bài mẫu Level B1 275 từ
Bấm vào câu bất kỳ để xem dịch nghĩa tiếng Việt

Nowadays, stress has become a common problem for many young people in their daily lives. Whether they are students or young workers, they often feel tired and worried about many things. This essay will discuss the main causes of stress among young people.

One major cause of stress is pressure from study and work. Many students have to deal with a lot of homework, difficult exams and high expectations from their parents. They often worry about getting good grades so that they can enter a good university or find a well-paid job in the future. Similarly, young people who have already started working often face long working hours and strict deadlines. In addition, the high cost of living makes many young workers worry about earning enough money to pay for rent, food and other daily expenses.

Another important reason is the influence of social media and an unhealthy lifestyle. Nowadays, young people spend a lot of time on platforms such as Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. When they see others sharing pictures of their successful careers, expensive clothes or happy lives, they often compare themselves with other people and feel that they are not good enough. Furthermore, many youngsters do not get enough sleep or exercise because they stay up late studying, working or using their smartphones. As a result, their bodies and minds cannot rest properly, which makes them feel even more stressed.

In conclusion, stress among young people mainly comes from study and work pressure, social media comparison and unhealthy daily habits. Therefore, it is important for young people to manage their time well and take care of both their physical and mental health.

GỢI Ý DÀN BÀI · WRITING TASK 2 · LEVEL B2

I. Mở bài

  1. Dẫn dắt bối cảnh học thuật: trong xã hội hiện đại, ngày càng nhiều người trẻ chịu đựng căng thẳng trong đời sống thường ngày — từ yêu cầu học tập đến áp lực cá nhân, đây là mối quan ngại lớn với gia đình và nhà giáo dục.
    In modern society, an increasing number of young people suffer from ... From academic demands to ..., this issue has become ...
  2. Nêu mục tiêu bài viết chuẩn B2 (examine the main factors behind ...): phân tích các yếu tố chính đằng sau mức độ căng thẳng gia tăng ở giới trẻ.
    This essay will examine the main factors behind the rising levels of stress among youngsters.

II. Thân bài 1 — Áp lực học tập, sự nghiệp và gánh nặng tài chính

  1. Câu chủ đề học thuật: Nguyên nhân hàng đầu là áp lực lớn liên quan đến giáo dục và phát triển sự nghiệp.
    One primary cause of stress among young people is intense pressure related to education and career development.
  2. Nhóm học sinh – sinh viên: Khối lượng bài vở nặng (heavy academic workloads), kỳ thi cạnh tranh (competitive examinations) và kỳ vọng cao → lo âu đạt điểm cao để giành suất vào trường đại học uy tín (reputable university).
    Many students face ... As a result, they often feel anxious about ... in order to secure a place at ...
  3. Nhóm người trẻ đã đi làm (đảo ngữ Not only ... but also + phân từ V-ing): Áp lực không kém phần khắt khe — không chỉ xử lý thời hạn gấp và cạnh tranh gay gắt mà còn vật lộn áp lực tài chính, khó trang trải chi phí sinh hoạt và tiết kiệm.
    For young adults who have entered the workforce, ... Not only do they have to handle ..., but they also struggle with ..., making it difficult to ...

III. Thân bài 2 — Tác động của mạng xã hội và lối sống mất cân bằng

  1. Câu chủ đề: Một yếu tố đáng kể khác là tác động tiêu cực của mạng xã hội kết hợp với lối sống thiếu lành mạnh.
    Another significant factor is the negative impact of social media combined with an unhealthy lifestyle.
  2. Mạng xã hội & tự ti (V-ing làm chủ ngữ): Dành hàng giờ trên nền tảng mạng xã hội khiến người trẻ liên tục tiếp xúc hình ảnh được lý tưởng hóa về thành công, giàu có và ngoại hình → hình thành thói quen so sánh, dẫn tới tự nghi ngờ bản thân (self-doubt).
    Spending hours on ... constantly exposes young people to ... Consequently, many of them develop a habit of ..., which can easily lead to ...
  3. Lối sống bận rộn & thiếu ngủ: Nhịp sống bận rộn để lại ít thời gian tập thể dục, thư giãn hay ngủ đủ giấc; thức khuya lướt điện thoại ngăn tâm trí hồi phục đúng cách, dần làm tăng mức độ căng thẳng.
    Moreover, a busy routine often leaves young people with little time for ... Staying up late to ... prevents their minds from ..., gradually worsening ...

IV. Kết bài

  1. Dùng động từ học thuật (largely stems from ...) tổng kết 3 nhóm nguyên nhân và đưa cụm mục đích đầu câu (To protect their mental well-being, ...) kèm chuỗi 3 hành động song song (set realistic goals, limit screen time, maintain a healthier balance).
    In conclusion, stress among young people largely stems from ... To protect their mental well-being, youngsters should learn to ..., ... and maintain a healthier balance between work and rest.

V. Điểm nâng cấp từ B1 lên B2

So sánh các nâng cấp về từ vựng chuyên đề sức khỏe tinh thần – áp lực xã hội và cấu trúc câu phức (đảo ngữ Not only ... but also, chủ ngữ V-ing, phân từ rút gọn) giúp bài viết đạt chuẩn Level B2.

1. Nâng cấp từ vựng & cụm từ cố định
Cách viết Level B1 Nâng cấp lên Level B2 Vì sao giúp tăng điểm B2
a lot of homework, difficult exams heavy academic workloads, competitive examinations Cụm danh từ học thuật chính xác hơn nhiều so với cách diễn đạt chung chung (a lot of homework).

pictures of their successful careers, expensive clothes idealized images of success, wealth and appearance Cụm danh từ khái quát hóa sắc nét (idealized images of ...) nâng rõ tầm từ vựng B2.
feel that they are not good enough lead to self-doubt and emotional pressure Danh từ tâm lý học chính xác (self-doubt, emotional pressure) thay cho mệnh đề khẩu ngữ.

2. Nâng cấp cấu trúc ngữ pháp & liên kết câu
Cách viết Level B1 Nâng cấp lên Level B2 Vì sao giúp tăng điểm B2
They face strict deadlines. In addition, the high cost of living makes them worry... Not only do they have to handle tight deadlines and fierce competition at work, but they also struggle with financial pressure, making it difficult to cover daily living expenses... Kết hợp đảo ngữ Not only do they ... but they also ... và mệnh đề phân từ kết quả (making it difficult to ...) ăn điểm cao tiêu chí Grammar.
When they see others sharing pictures ..., they often compare ... Spending hours on social networking platforms constantly exposes young people to ... Dùng cụm V-ing làm chủ ngữ (Spending hours on ... exposes ...) tăng độ súc tích và học thuật.
Their bodies and minds cannot rest properly, which makes them feel even more stressed. Staying up late ... prevents their minds from recovering properly, gradually worsening their stress levels. Dùng cấu trúc prevent sb/sth from V-ing kết hợp cụm phân từ kết quả (gradually worsening ...) rất tự nhiên ở band B2.
Therefore, it is important for young people to manage their time well... To protect their mental well-being, youngsters should learn to set realistic goals, limit screen time and maintain a healthier balance... Đưa mệnh đề mục đích (To protect ...) lên đầu câu kèm cấu trúc song song 3 động từ mạch lạc.

Bài mẫu Level B2 286 từ
Bấm vào câu bất kỳ để xem dịch nghĩa tiếng Việt

In modern society, an increasing number of young people suffer from stress in their everyday lives. From academic demands to personal pressures, this issue has become a growing concern for both families and educators. This essay will examine the main factors behind the rising levels of stress among youngsters.

One primary cause of stress among young people is intense pressure related to education and career development. Many students face heavy academic workloads, competitive examinations and high expectations from parents and teachers. As a result, they often feel anxious about achieving top grades in order to secure a place at a reputable university. For young adults who have entered the workforce, the pressure is equally demanding. Not only do they have to handle tight deadlines and fierce competition at work, but they also struggle with financial pressure, making it difficult to cover daily living expenses and save for the future.

Another significant factor is the negative impact of social media combined with an unhealthy lifestyle. Spending hours on social networking platforms constantly exposes young people to idealized images of success, wealth and appearance. Consequently, many of them develop a habit of comparing themselves with others, which can easily lead to self-doubt and emotional pressure. Moreover, a busy routine often leaves young people with little time for regular exercise, relaxation or sufficient sleep. Staying up late to study, work or scroll through smartphones prevents their minds from recovering properly, gradually worsening their stress levels.

In conclusion, stress among young people largely stems from academic and career pressures, social media comparison and an imbalanced lifestyle. To protect their mental well-being, youngsters should learn to set realistic goals, limit screen time and maintain a healthier balance between work and rest.

Bài mẫu Level B1 275 từ
Bấm vào câu bất kỳ để xem dịch nghĩa tiếng Việt

Nowadays, mobile phones and the Internet can bring many benefits to older people, even though they use these technologies less than younger generations. This essay will discuss how mobile phones and the Internet are useful for old people and suggest some ways to encourage them to use modern technology.

There are several ways in which mobile phones and the Internet can help older people. Firstly, these tools allow them to stay in touch with their family and friends easily. For example, elderly people can make video calls or send messages to their children and grandchildren who live far away. This helps them feel happier and less lonely. Secondly, the Internet makes their daily lives more convenient. Old people can read the news, watch videos for entertainment, or shop online from home. They can also search for health information and book doctor appointments without having to travel far.

Several measures can be taken to encourage older people to use this technology. First of all, family members should be patient and spend time teaching them how to use smartphones and basic apps step by step. In addition, local communities can organize free training classes where elderly people can practice using the Internet together. Finally, technology companies should design simpler devices for older users, such as phones with larger screens, bigger text and clear buttons. When devices are easier to use, old people will feel more confident.

In conclusion, mobile phones and the Internet are very helpful for older people because they improve communication and make daily life easier. With patient support from family, community classes and user-friendly devices, more elderly people will feel comfortable using new technology.

    Firstly, they help elderly people stay connected with ... For example, they can ..., especially when ... As a result, older people can ... and maintain close relationships with ...
  3. Lợi ích 2 (Tiện ích sinh hoạt & chăm sóc sức khỏe): Đọc tin mới nhất (latest news), xem video giải trí, mua đồ thiết yếu online mà không cần rời nhà (without leaving their homes); tra cứu thông tin y tế cơ bản và đặt lịch khám dễ hơn, đặc biệt hữu ích với người gặp khó khăn khi đi lại (those who have difficulty travelling).
    Secondly, the Internet makes their daily lives more convenient. They can ... without leaving their homes. Moreover, they can ..., which is especially helpful for those who have difficulty travelling.

III. Thân bài 2 — Giải pháp phối hợp từ gia đình, cộng đồng và doanh nghiệp công nghệ

  1. Câu chủ đề mở bằng cụm mục đích (To encourage older people to use modern technology, ...): cả gia đình và cộng đồng cần chung tay hỗ trợ.
    To encourage older people to use modern technology, both families and communities should provide support.
  2. Giải pháp 1 (Gia đình hướng dẫn rõ ràng, kiên nhẫn): Dạy dùng smartphone và ứng dụng cơ bản (basic applications); giải thích rõ từng bước vì người già ban đầu thường thấy công nghệ mới khó hiểu (find new technology difficult to understand at first).
    First, family members should spend time teaching ... They should be patient and explain each step clearly because ...
  3. Giải pháp 2 (Khóa đào tạo kỹ năng số miễn phí tại cộng đồng): Mở khóa học miễn phí giúp học kỹ năng số cơ bản (basic digital skills), thực hành dùng Internet và hỏi đáp trực tiếp khi gặp trục trặc.
    Second, local communities could organize free training courses to help them learn basic digital skills. In these classes, ...
  4. Giải pháp 3 (Phát triển thiết bị tối giản từ hãng công nghệ): Tạo thiết bị màn hình lớn, chữ to, nút dễ dùng (easy-to-use buttons) giúp họ cảm thấy thoải mái và tự tin hơn (comfortable and confident).
    Finally, technology companies should develop simpler devices with ... This would make older people feel ...

IV. Kết bài

  1. Khẳng định lại 2 lợi ích lớn (giao tiếp và tiện nghi hằng ngày) cùng sự đồng hành từ gia đình, cộng đồng và các hãng công nghệ để nhiều người cao tuổi ứng dụng được các công cụ hữu ích này.
    In conclusion, mobile phones and the Internet can help ... With support from ..., more elderly people can learn to use ...

V. Điểm nâng cấp từ B1 lên B2

So sánh các điểm nâng cấp tự nhiên về collocation và cách mở rộng lập luận chặt chẽ giúp bài luận Two-Part Question đạt độ phát triển ý sâu và thuyết phục chuẩn Level B2.

1. Nâng cấp từ vựng & cụm từ cố định
Cách viết Level B1 Nâng cấp lên Level B2 Vì sao giúp tăng điểm B2
help older people / stay in touch improve the lives of older people / stay connected / maintain close relationships with their loved ones Collocation học thuật và giàu sắc thái hơn (improve the lives of, maintain close relationships, loved ones).
read the news, watch videos for entertainment, or shop online read the latest news, watch entertaining videos and buy necessary items online without leaving their homes Tính từ cụ thể hơn (latest news, entertaining videos, necessary items) làm câu văn sinh động và chính xác.
without having to travel far which is especially helpful for those who have difficulty travelling Dùng cấu trúc học thuật chuẩn B2 (have difficulty + V-ing) để chỉ đúng đối tượng hưởng lợi.
basic apps / free training classes basic applications / free training courses / basic digital skills Dùng từ vựng đầy đủ, trang trọng hơn (applications thay cho apps, digital skills đúng chủ đề công nghệ).
clear buttons / feel more confident easy-to-use buttons / feel more comfortable and confident Tính từ ghép chuẩn tự nhiên (easy-to-use) và cặp tính từ song song tăng độ trôi chảy cho câu kết đoạn.
2. Nâng cấp cấu trúc ngữ pháp & liên kết câu
Cách viết Level B1 Nâng cấp lên Level B2 Vì sao giúp tăng điểm B2
... even though they use these technologies less than younger generations. Although older people are less likely to use these technologies than younger generations, they can still bring many benefits to the elderly. Dùng cấu trúc dự đoán học thuật (be less likely to V) trong mệnh đề nhượng bộ đầu câu.
They can also search for health information and book doctor appointments without having to travel far. Moreover, they can look for basic health information and book doctor's appointments more easily, which is especially helpful for those who have difficulty travelling. Kết hợp mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (, which is especially helpful for ...) và đại từ those who ....
Several measures can be taken to encourage older people... To encourage older people to use modern technology, both families and communities should provide support. Mở đoạn bằng cụm mục đích (To encourage ...) kèm câu chủ đề nêu rõ chủ thể thực hiện giải pháp.
Family members should be patient and spend time teaching them... They should be patient and explain each step clearly because older people may find new technology difficult to understand at first. Dùng cấu trúc find + N + adj + to V giải thích rõ nguyên nhân đằng sau giải pháp, tăng chiều sâu lập luận.

VI. Từ vựng nên dùng (Level B2)

Từ vựng Từ loại Nghĩa tiếng Việt Ví dụ trong câu
play an important role in v. phr. đóng vai trò quan trọng trong Public parks play an important role in improving air quality across dense cities.
be less likely to adj. phr. ít có khả năng / xu hướng hơn Shoppers are less likely to buy unfamiliar brands without reading customer reviews.
maintain close relationships v. phr. duy trì các mối quan hệ gắn bó Regular family dinners help relatives maintain close relationships despite busy jobs.
loved ones n. phr. những người thân yêu Travellers always bring back small souvenirs to share with their loved ones.
necessary items n. phr. các vật dụng thiết yếu Make a short checklist of necessary items before packing for a camping trip.
have difficulty + V-ing v. phr. gặp khó khăn khi làm gì Many exchange students have difficulty understanding fast regional accents at first.
basic applications n. phr. các ứng dụng cơ bản Most new tablets come preloaded with basic applications for email and calendars.
basic digital skills n. phr. kỹ năng số cơ bản Community workshops equip job seekers with basic digital skills for office work.
easy-to-use adj. dễ sử dụng The museum launched an easy-to-use audio guide available in six languages.
everyday lives n. phr. cuộc sống thường ngày Contactless cards have simplified payment routines in people's everyday lives.
Bài mẫu Level B2 328 từ
Bấm vào câu bất kỳ để xem dịch nghĩa tiếng Việt

Nowadays, mobile phones and the Internet play an important role in modern life. Although older people are less likely to use these technologies than younger generations, they can still bring many benefits to the elderly. This essay will discuss their advantages and suggest some ways to encourage older people to use them.

There are several ways in which mobile phones and the Internet can improve the lives of older people. Firstly, they help elderly people stay connected with their family and friends. For example, they can make video calls or send messages to their children and grandchildren, especially when they live far away. As a result, older people can feel less lonely and maintain close relationships with their loved ones. Secondly, the Internet makes their daily lives more convenient. They can read the latest news, watch entertaining videos and buy necessary items online without leaving their homes. Moreover, they can look for basic health information and book doctor's appointments more easily, which is especially helpful for those who have difficulty travelling.

To encourage older people to use modern technology, both families and communities should provide support. First, family members should spend time teaching elderly people how to use smartphones and basic applications. They should be patient and explain each step clearly because older people may find new technology difficult to understand at first. Second, local communities could organize free training courses to help them learn basic digital skills. In these classes, elderly people can practise using the Internet and ask questions when they have problems. Finally, technology companies should develop simpler devices with larger screens, bigger text and easy-to-use buttons. This would make older people feel more comfortable and confident when using technology.

In conclusion, mobile phones and the Internet can help older people communicate with others and make their daily lives more convenient. With support from their families, local communities and technology companies, more elderly people can learn to use these useful tools in their everyday lives.

GỢI Ý DÀN BÀI · WRITING TASK 2 · LEVEL B1

IV. Kết bài

  1. Tóm tắt hai mặt lợi ích (ánh sáng tự nhiên, tầm nhìn đẹp) và bất cập (tăng tiêu thụ năng lượng, khiến một số nhân viên không thoải mái), kết luận cần cân nhắc cả hai phía.

V. Từ vựng nên dùng (Level B1)

Từ vựng Từ loại Nghĩa tiếng Việt Ví dụ trong câu

save electricity v. phr. tiết kiệm điện năng Turning off unused fans before leaving a classroom is a simple way to save electricity.

Bài mẫu Level B1 260 từ
Bấm vào câu bất kỳ để xem dịch nghĩa tiếng Việt

Nowadays, modern glass office buildings are becoming more common in many cities. This essay will discuss both its positive and negative effects of working in modern glass buildings.

On the one hand, working in glass office buildings can have some positive effects. Firstly, large glass windows allow more natural light to enter the workplace. This helps workers see things more clearly and reduces the need to turn on electric lights during the day. As a result, companies can save electricity and reduce their costs. Secondly, these buildings often provide beautiful views of the city and the surrounding areas. Workers can look outside during short breaks, which may help them feel more relaxed and improve their mood. This can make the working environment more pleasant.

On the other hand, there are also some negative effects. Firstly, glass office buildings can use a large amount of energy, especially in hot weather. Sunlight can make the rooms very warm, so air conditioners have to work for many hours. This increases electricity consumption and has a negative impact on the environment. Secondly, working in these buildings may cause stress for some employees because they have less privacy. For example, people may feel uncomfortable when others can easily see what they are doing through large glass windows. This can make it difficult for them to concentrate on their work.

In conclusion, modern glass office buildings offer benefits such as natural light and beautiful views. However, they can also increase energy use and make some workers feel uncomfortable. Therefore, both advantages and disadvantages should be considered.

    Firstly, their large windows allow plenty of ... This creates ... It also reduces the need for ..., helping companies ...

    On the other hand, this type of workplace also has several negative impacts.
  2. Tác động tiêu cực 1 (Tiêu thụ năng lượng cao — phân từ V-ing + not only ... but also): Ánh nắng đi qua cửa kính lớn (Sunlight passing through ...) làm phòng cực kỳ nóng, đồng nghĩa điều hòa phải vận hành thời gian dài → không chỉ tăng hóa đơn điện mà còn góp phần gây vấn đề môi trường.
    One major problem is its high energy consumption, particularly in ... Sunlight passing through ... can make ..., meaning that ... This not only increases ... but also contributes to ...
  3. Tác động tiêu cực 2 (Thiếu riêng tư & áp lực tâm lý): Tường kính khiến người khác dễ nhìn vào trong nên một số nhân viên thấy không thoải mái hoặc lo bị giám sát (worried about being watched) → khó tập trung và căng thẳng hơn khi làm việc.
    Another negative impact is the lack of privacy. Since glass walls make it easier for ..., some employees may feel ... As a result, they may find it harder to ...

IV. Kết bài

  1. Tổng kết cân bằng: tòa nhà kính mang lại ánh sáng tự nhiên và tầm nhìn đẹp giúp cải thiện trải nghiệm làm việc, nhưng mức tiêu thụ năng lượng cao và thiếu riêng tư cũng tạo ra nhiều vấn đề cho cả người lao động lẫn môi trường.
    In conclusion, modern glass office buildings provide ..., which can improve ... However, their high energy use and lack of privacy can also create problems for both ...

V. Điểm nâng cấp từ B1 lên B2

So sánh các nâng cấp về thuật ngữ chuyên đề kiến trúc – năng lượng – tâm lý công sở và cấu trúc câu phức (phân từ V-ing rút gọn, not only ... but also, bị động V-ing being watched) giúp bài luận đạt chuẩn Level B2.

1. Nâng cấp từ vựng & cụm từ cố định
Cách viết Level B1 Nâng cấp lên Level B2 Vì sao giúp tăng điểm B2
more common / turn on electric lights increasingly popular / artificial lighting Cụm danh từ học thuật (artificial lighting) thay cho cụm động từ mô tả dài dòng của B1.
reduce their costs / look outside lower their energy bills / enjoy the scenery outside Collocation chính xác theo ngữ cảnh (lower energy bills, enjoy the scenery).
use a large amount of energy / work for many hours high energy consumption / operate for long periods Danh từ hóa (high energy consumption) và động từ chuẩn kỹ thuật (operate thay cho work với máy móc).
have a negative impact on the environment contributes to environmental problems Động từ học thuật tự nhiên (contribute to) tránh lặp lại cụm negative impact đã dùng ở câu chủ đề.
have less privacy / see what they are doing the lack of privacy / worried about being watched Danh từ chuẩn học thuật (lack of privacy) và dạng bị động V-ing (being watched) ngắn gọn, sắc nét.
2. Nâng cấp cấu trúc ngữ pháp & liên kết câu
Cách viết Level B1 Nâng cấp lên Level B2 Vì sao giúp tăng điểm B2
This reduces the need... As a result, companies can save electricity... It also reduces the need for artificial lighting during the day, helping companies save electricity and lower their energy bills. Rút gọn câu kết quả thành cụm phân từ hiện tại (, helping companies ...) tạo sự liền mạch chuẩn B2.
Sunlight can make the rooms very warm, so air conditioners have to work... Sunlight passing through large glass windows can make office rooms extremely warm, meaning that air conditioners need to operate for long periods. Kết hợp mệnh đề quan hệ rút gọn (passing through ...) và cụm phân từ giải thích hệ quả (, meaning that ...).
This increases electricity consumption and has a negative impact... This not only increases electricity bills but also contributes to environmental problems. Cấu trúc song song nhấn mạnh hai hệ quả (not only ... but also ...) tăng điểm Grammatical Range.
This can make it difficult for them to concentrate on their work. As a result, they may find it harder to concentrate and feel more stressed while working. Cấu trúc find it + comparative adj + to V kết hợp rút gọn trạng ngữ thời gian (while working).

VI. Từ vựng nên dùng (Level B2)

Từ vựng Từ loại Nghĩa tiếng Việt Ví dụ trong câu
artificial lighting n. phr. ánh sáng nhân tạo Greenhouses rely on artificial lighting during short winter afternoons to keep crops growing.
energy bills n. phr. hóa đơn tiền điện / năng lượng Installing roof solar panels helped the suburban school cut its monthly energy bills.
enjoy the scenery v. phr. ngắm cảnh đẹp Passengers on the mountain railway often sit near the window to enjoy the scenery.
high energy consumption n. phr. mức tiêu thụ năng lượng cao Older manufacturing factories are upgrading machinery to tackle high energy consumption.
operate for long periods v. phr. vận hành trong thời gian dài Industrial refrigerators must be serviced regularly when they operate for long periods.
contribute to v. phr. góp phần dẫn đến Heavy rush-hour traffic continues to contribute to poor air quality in central districts.
lack of privacy n. phr. sự thiếu riêng tư Open-plan libraries sometimes receive complaints about noise and a lack of privacy.
being watched v. phr. (passive) bị quan sát, theo dõi Some nervous speakers lose confidence when they feel they are constantly being watched.
find it harder to v. phr. cảm thấy khó hơn khi làm gì Commuters often find it harder to read books on crowded evening trains.
working experience n. phr. trải nghiệm làm việc Ergonomic chairs and quiet break rooms significantly improve staff working experience.
Bài mẫu Level B2 282 từ
Bấm vào câu bất kỳ để xem dịch nghĩa tiếng Việt

Nowadays, modern glass office buildings are becoming increasingly popular in many cities. Working in these buildings can bring both advantages and disadvantages to employees and the environment. This essay will discuss both the positive and negative effects of this working environment.

On the one hand, glass office buildings can offer several benefits. Firstly, their large windows allow plenty of natural light to enter the workplace. This creates a brighter and more comfortable environment for employees. It also reduces the need for artificial lighting during the day, helping companies save electricity and lower their energy bills. Moreover, these buildings often offer attractive views of the city. During short breaks, employees can enjoy the scenery outside instead of looking at their computer screens all the time. This can help them relax, reduce stress and return to work with a better mood.

On the other hand, this type of workplace also has several negative impacts. One major problem is its high energy consumption, particularly in countries with hot weather. Sunlight passing through large glass windows can make office rooms extremely warm, meaning that air conditioners need to operate for long periods. This not only increases electricity bills but also contributes to environmental problems. Another negative impact is the lack of privacy. Since glass walls make it easier for others to see inside, some employees may feel uncomfortable or worried about being watched. As a result, they may find it harder to concentrate and feel more stressed while working.

In conclusion, modern glass office buildings provide natural light and attractive views, which can improve employees' working experience. However, their high energy use and lack of privacy can also create problems for both workers and the environment.
